meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在每次回复前会自动检索并参考之前的对话记忆;每轮对话结束后,会主动把值得记住的信息存入长期记忆,换新会话仍能想起。
howto.when: 每次 Claude 准备回答你的问题时,会先翻阅往期记忆;回答完毕,又会将有用的新信息记下来。

say.text: 你还记得之前讨论过的项目代号吗?
say.note: Claude 会从记忆里翻找相关内容再作答。
该信息会被存入长期记忆。

say.text: 上次你建议我用的那个工具叫什么?
say.note: 即使是新对话也能凭记忆答出。

howto.what_en: After installation, before replying Claude automatically reviews its stored memories for relevant context, and after each turn it saves any noteworthy insights, so it can recall past discussions even in new sessions.
howto.when_en: Each time Claude is about to answer, it first checks related memories; once the reply is done, it records useful new details for later use.

say_en.text: Do you still remember the project codename we discussed earlier?
say_en.note: Claude searches memory for the relevant context and answers.

say_en.text: Remember: rent is due on the 5th of each month.
say_en.note: This detail is saved to long-term memory.

say_en.text: What was that tool you suggested last time?
say_en.note: It can recall this even in a new session.
